mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, investors anticipate higher future inflation, which lowers real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
regime_hint: Rising FED Funds rate after a period of rate cuts
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the trigger period (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS rise is < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) by at least 10,000 jobs over two consecutive months predicts stronger consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous_month + 10000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite the employment increase, or the increase is <10,000 jobs in either month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 (real GDP) by 2% or more in the prior quarter is associated with reduced business confidence and a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate weaker earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive during the contraction quarter, or GDP growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of 5% or more signals supply-side weakness, which reduces market optimism and yields negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO decline, or decline <5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 5% for three consecutive months, monetary policy is expected to stay restrictive, compressing equity valuations and producing a negative 20-day S&P 500 return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive during the low-unemployment period, or UNRATE never drops below 5% in the window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (housing starts) and PAYEMS (jobs) above their prior month averages by at least 15% each is interpreted as a dual-demand signal, resulting in a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: Simultaneous surge in housing and labor markets
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or either proxy does not exceed 15% increase.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS > 4%, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to higher real borrowing costs and reduced equity risk appetite.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive during the high-rate period, or FEDFUNDS never exceed 4% in the window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS (retail sales) decline of 8% or more indicates consumer weakness, which tends to precede a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as sentiment turns cautious.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite the sales decline, or decline is <8%.
